description: This bar chart illustrates the difference in Average Word Error Rate (WER) from Whisper large for different models, specifically comparing NESCAC ft model and SESHA ft model. The horizontal axis displays the model names: Americanisms, Dates, Optimisations, Add Spacing, and Normalised, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Difference in Average WER from Whisper large”, represents the WER difference, with a linear scale ranging from 0.000 to 0.0035, with tick marks at 0.000, 0.001, 0.002, and 0.003. Each model name has two adjacent bars representing the WER difference for NESCAC ft model (in green) and SESHA ft model (in orange). For Americanisms, the NESCAC ft model bar reaches approximately 0.00299, while the SESHA ft model bar reaches approximately 0.00302. For Dates, the NESCAC ft model bar reaches approximately 0.00257, while the SESHA ft model bar reaches approximately 0.00228. For Optimisations, the NESCAC ft model bar reaches approximately 0.00319, while the SESHA ft model bar reaches approximately 0.00344. For Add Spacing, the NESCAC ft model bar reaches approximately 0.00311, while the SESHA ft model bar reaches approximately 0.00306. For Normalised, the NESCAC ft model bar reaches approximately 0.00334, while the SESHA ft model bar reaches approximately 0.00323. The bars are arranged side-by-side for each model, with the NESCAC ft model consistently displayed to the left and the SESHA ft model to the right.
